caption:
The holidays are right around the corner and that means travel for many Edmontonians- myself included! 🧳 
 
If you’re flying via the Edmonton International Airport, you will notice a variety of changes due to ongoing infrastructure upgrades @FlyYeg. The Departures Roadway on level two and Arrivals Roadway at ground level are currently closed to all public traffic and will remain so well into 2024. 
 
There are lots of great ways get to and from of the airport. My family and I find it easiest to Park at Value Park or JetSet and utilize the free shuttles. You can also take a taxi, Uber, Lyft or public transit. All these options get you right to the door!
 
If you are being dropped-off or picked-up by friends or family, the Pick-up and Drop-off Area has been relocated east of the 4-storey parkade. Simply walk through the covered parkade into the airport. Plan for an additional 3-5 minutes to get where you need to go! 
 
If you’re getting picked up, exit the terminal through door 7 or 8, walk through the Parkade and look for your ride. 
 
Additionally, If you have accessibility or mobility requirements, you may still be dropped off and picked up on the Arrivals roadway on ground level. 
 
If you have any questions, look for a YEG staff member, there are so many friendly and helpful folks to help you along the way.
 
Wishing you and yours safe and Happy Travels this holiday season! ✈️

caption:
#AD This holiday season, we are switching up our usual stuffing recipe and adding in our families’ favorite ingredients - @KingsHawaiian Original Hawaiian Sweet Rolls! 😋
 
King’s Hawaiian Rolls are so versatile and have the perfect touch of sweetness, which lends itself so perfectly to elevate our classic stuffing recipe! 🤍
 
Here’s what you’ll need:
- 2x 12 pack King’s Hawaiian Original Hawaiian Sweet Rolls
- 4 cloves garlic (pressed)
- 1 medium white onion (shredded)
- 4-5 stalks celery (thinly chopped)
- 1-2 carrots (diced) 
- 1/2 green apple (cubed)
- 1 leek, thinly Sliced
- 1 Tbsp Extra Virgin olive oil (divided)
- 1/3 cup chicken stock
- 1 Tbsp rosemary
- 1 Tbsp thyme
- Salt + pepper to taste 
 
Method:
- preheat your oven to 375 Fahrenheit 
- with a sharp knife, cube your Kings Hawaiian Rolls
- place cubed rolls on a cooking sheet and drizzle with olive oil, sprinkle with garlic and salt and pepper 
- toast in oven until golden brown (approx. five minutes) then remove and set aside.
- in a skillet, over medium heat, sauté onions and garlic in olive oil
- once translucent, add in celery, carrot and apple
- stir occasionally until fruit and vegetables are soft
- add in toasted sweet rolls and chicken stock
- stir gently with a spatula to combine 
- add rosemary, thyme and leek
- season with salt and pepper
- reduce heat to simmer and cover for about 5 minutes until cubed toasted rolls have softened. 
 
Bon Appétit!! Hope you enjoy this delectable dish this holiday season! Don’t forget- you can now find the delicious King’s Hawaiian Rolls in Canada at your local Loblaws and SaveOn Foods locations! 🧡

caption:
You guys know how much I love creating in my kitchen! #ad One of my favourite things to do is to put my own unique spin on restaurant dishes I’ve tried, by using wonderful ingredients - like Hunt’s Heirloom Tomatoes - to elevate our meals at home! That’s exactly what I’ve done with this latest recipe. For this mouth-watering dish, I’ve based it off Chef Alida Solomon’s Tomato Mozzarella Antipasto, and added my own fun twist! Recipe below👇
 
Hunt’s is a great way to experience fresh-tasting tomatoes (even when it’s from a can!!) by including it in delicious and creative recipes. Plus, I love that Hunt’s Heirloom Tomatoes offer a wide variety of tomato products are available at my nearest retailer! 🍅
 
It’s a perfect time to try out new recipes that can shine in your holiday meal lineup! Find more great recipe inspo at https://bit.ly/RCShuntsheirloom 🍝
 
 
Hunt’s Heirloom Tomato, Truffle and Parmesan Crostini 
 
2 398ml cans of Hunt’s Heirloom Diced Tomatoes
1/2 Cup Parmesan cheese, shaved
1 bunch Fresh Basil 
4 Cloves of Garlic
4 TBSP Extra Virgin Olive Oil 
6 Slices of Toasted Baguette
1 TSP Truffled Honey
 
STEP ONE
Toast 1” slices of bread until browned. Rub a clove of garlic over the toasted bread surface for added flavour.
 
STEP TWO
In a bowl, add 2 cans of Hunt’s Heirloom Diced Tomatoes, chopped garlic and extra virgin olive oil and toss until combined. Season with a pinch of salt.
 
STEP THREE
Shave Parmesan into thin slices. Take basil and roughly break apart into smaller pieces. 
 
STEP FOUR
Take toasted bread slices and spoon on the tomato mixture on top. Lay parmesan shavings and basil over tomatoes. Drizzle with truffled honey, serve and enjoy!
 
Saluti!

caption:
Ever since I was little, Granny Smith apples have been my absolute favorite! #ad🍏

Funnily enough, it was my Grandma Willma that introduced them to me as a young child! Then, later in my teenage years, she taught me how to make her incredible Apple Cobbler, featuring Granny Smith Apples, of course! 😉 My Grandma instilled in me that Granny Smith Apples are always the best choice for baking- especially for friends and family during the holidays! 

I cherish those memories with my Grandma (in and out of the Kitchen!) more than anything, and I feel so honored that she has passed on so many meaningful recipes to me. 

This warm and comforting Apple Cobbler is a staple for our annual Thanksgiving Feast, and with only a few simple ingredients, I know it will be a great addition to your table too! 🥧

Prep Time: 5 Mins. Bake time: 40 mins. Serves 9.

Ingredients:

5 Large California grown Granny Smith Apples (sliced)
One Lemon (half juiced, half zested)
3 Tbsp Splenda blend Brown Sugar
1 cup Oats, old-fashioned
2 Tbsp Cinnamon, divided
pinch of Himalayan sea salt
1/2 cup raw, unsalted Almonds (sliced or slivered)
1/4 cup Coconut oil or butter
3 tbsp. almond or cashew milk
Method:

1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.
2. Wash apples and peel apples if you wish (we keep the skin on) slice thinly into bite size pieces.
3. In a large bowl, toss apples with cinnamon and lemon juice
4. Grease a 9x9 Baking pan and layer apples along the bottom.
5. In the same (now empty) bowl, add oats, nuts, cinnamon, salt, coconut oil or butter, and brown sugar.
6. Add the almond/cashew milk to help bind the crumble topping together and press into baking dish on top of apples.
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes, until apples are soft. 
8. Cover pan loosely with aluminum foil halfway through to prevent from over-browning.
9. Serve warm with a generous dollop of vanilla frozen yogurt or Ice cream.

Enjoy!

caption:
As the days become longer and the the weather warmer, I find myself craving lighter, more refreshing meals- like this vibrant, layered spring salad with grilled @albertaturkey 🥗

The variety of veggies provides bold flavor and textures, crispy oven roasted chickpeas bring the “crunch” and the grilled Turkey Breast completes the meal perfectly as a lean, delicious protein! 

A crowd pleaser in our home, and sure to be yours too! Recipe Details 👇

Prep Time: 10 mins, Cook Time: 20 mins 
Serves 4.

Ingredients

For Salad:
- 3 Large Golden (or red) Beets, cooked and cubed
-4 Large Carrots, shredded
-2 Watermelon Radishes (thinly sliced)
-1/2 Red onion, thinly sliced
-1 can Chickpeas, roasted
-1 Tbsp Olive Oil
-1 tsp Paprika
-2 Heads Romaine Lettuce, chopped
-1 Bunch Kale, chopped

For Dressing:
1 Tbsp Olive Oil
1 Tbsp Apple Cider Vinegar
2 cloves garlic, pressed
1 Tsp honey (or sweetener)
Salt + Pepper to taste (approx 1 tsp each)

For Turkey:
2 Medium Turkey Breasts (approx 5 Oz each)
1 Tbsp Olive Oil
1 tsp Paprika
1 tsp Garlic Powder
1 tsp Onion Powder
Salt + Pepper to taste 

Method:

1. Preheat oven to 425 F
2. Start Barbecue
3. In a saucepan over medium heat, bring water to boil and cook beets.
Once tender, remove beets from stove and let cool
4. Slice and chop all other vegetables 
5. Toss chickpeas in Olive Oil + Paprika and roast on a cooking sheet in oven 5-10 mins until crispy 
6. Season Turkey and grill on Barbecue 
7. Once Turkey is cooked through (internal temperature of 165 degrees F) remove from grill
Prepare salad dressing.
8. Arrange vegetables on plate, top with sliced Turkey breast and dressing. Garnish with crispy chickpeas

Enjoy! ☀️

caption:
After the year we've had, we are more excited than ever to celebrate the Spring season, and what better way to do so than by enjoying an amazing Strawberry Basil Smash (or two) on the patio?!? 🍹
 
#ad Made with sweet and delicious @castrawberries 🍓herbaceous basil and a honey simple syrup, you will be mixing up this delightful bevy allll summer long! 
 
Right now, California Strawberries are in peak season, are readily available and an excellent source of Vitamin C (a serving of 8 strawberries has the same amount as an orange)! You can find organic and conventionally grown strawberries from California at grocery and natural product stores near you.
 
Recipe Details 
Prep Time : 10 Mins, Serves Two

Here's What you Need:
8 Oz California Strawberries, rinsed and roughly chopped
1 Tbsp Honey
3 Cups Water
10 Leaves Fresh Basil
4 0z Vodka of choice
6 Oz Sparkling Water

Method:
- In a saucepan, over medium heat make your simple syrup by adding honey and water together.
- Bring to a boil and allow liquid to reduce to half.
Once reduced, remove from heat and add 5 leaves of fresh basil. Set aside and let cool.
- In a cocktail mixing glass, muddle chopped California strawberries to desired texture (we like our strawberry pieces to be about the size of a quarter- but you do you!).
- Add vodka and 2 tsp simple syrup, and a handful of ice to mixing glass and stir vigorously until well combined.
- Pour mixture into glassware of choice and top with sparkling water.
Garnish with extra basil + Enjoy! 
 
Add a taste of Summer to any dish with California Strawberries! 🍓🤍 For more information, recipe ideas and tips, visit californiastrawberries.com
